mapper.select: SELECT id FROM finance_resource WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND resource_type='ADVANCE' AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advance_overdue_reminder WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND advance_id=#{id}

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.advance_id,p.due_on,p.trace_id,NULL AS business_no,NULL AS process_instance_id FROM employee_advance_order p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND p.employee_id=#{argument2} AND p.legal_entity_id=#{argument3} AND p.due_on<#{argument4} AND (p.due_on>#{argument5} OR (p.due_on=#{argument6} AND p.advance_id>#{argument7})) ORDER BY p.due_on,p.advance_id LIMIT 100

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.advance_id,p.due_on,p.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM employee_advance_order p JOIN advance_request a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.advance_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND business.id=a.application_id LEFT JOIN payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND origin.business_type='ADVANCE_REQUEST' AND origin.active_business_id=p.advance_id AND origin.application_id=business.id AND origin.purpose='EMPLOYEE_ADVANCE' AND origin.status='EXECUTION_REGISTERED' LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE p.due_on<#{argument1} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advance_overdue_reminder n WHERE n.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND n.advance_id=p.advance_id) AND (p.due_on>#{argument2} OR (p.due_on=#{argument3} AND (p.tenant_id>#{argument4} OR (p.tenant_id=#{argument5} AND p.advance_id>#{argument6})))) ORDER BY p.due_on,p.tenant_id,p.advance_id LIMIT 100
